beats.title: Turin Papyrus Maps a Gold Mine
beats.description: An Egyptian scribe drew a map of a gold-mining district in the eastern desert, among the oldest surviving maps of any kind.
beats.note: Approximate date, c. 1150 BCE (reign of Ramesses IV); sources agree.

beats.title: Silver Strike at Laurion
beats.description: A rich new vein in the Athenian silver mines paid for a fleet of warships that would soon face an invading empire.

beats.title: Rome Mines the Gold of Las Medulas
beats.description: After conquering the northwest of Spain, engineers began washing whole mountains away with aqueducts to reach the gold inside.
beats.note: Sources disagree: UNESCO says 1st century AD, others say about 25 BCE under Augustus. Used 25 BCE; approximate.

beats.title: Trajan Seizes the Gold of Dacia
beats.description: An emperor's conquest of a mountain kingdom brought home a vast treasure of gold and opened its mines to the empire.

beats.title: Silver Found at Kutna Hora
beats.description: A rich silver seam in Bohemia set off a boom that built a wealthy mining town and supplied the groschen coin to Europe.
beats.note: Silver was first mined near Sedlec c. 1260; the major boom and big discovery dated c. 1298.

beats.title: Silver Rush at Joachimsthal
beats.description: A silver strike in the Bohemian mountains led to coins that gave the world the name of a future dollar.

beats.title: Silver Found at Potosi
beats.description: A mountain of silver in the Andes was discovered and became the richest source of the metal in the known world.

beats.title: Silver Strike at Zacatecas
beats.description: Prospectors in the Mexican highlands struck rich veins that launched one of the largest silver mining centres of the Spanish world.

beats.title: Gold Found in Minas Gerais
beats.description: Prospectors in the Brazilian interior found gold in river gravels, starting the first great gold rush of the Americas.

beats.title: Diamonds Found in Brazil
beats.description: Miners panning for gold in the Brazilian highlands noticed sparkling stones, ending India's long monopoly on diamonds.

beats.title: Russia's First Gold at Berezovsk
beats.description: A peasant found gold-bearing quartz in the Ural Mountains, opening the first gold mines of the Russian empire.

beats.title: A 17-Pound Nugget in North Carolina
beats.description: A boy fishing in a creek found a gold rock so heavy his family used it as a doorstop until a jeweller named its worth.

beats.title: Georgia Gold Rush Begins
beats.description: Gold found in the Appalachian foothills drew thousands of prospectors and the country's first big rush, years before California.

beats.title: Gold at Sutter's Mill
beats.description: A carpenter spotted glittering flakes in a sawmill's millrace, setting off a stampede of hopefuls toward the West Coast.

beats.title: Ballarat Gold Rush
beats.description: Gold in the Victorian hills drew diggers from around the globe and transformed a colony into a magnet for fortune seekers.

beats.title: The Comstock Lode
beats.description: Miners clearing a nuisance of blue-grey sand in Nevada realised it was rich silver ore, making fortunes and a boom town.

beats.title: Gabriel's Gully Gold Rush
beats.description: A prospector's find in a creek bed in the far south of New Zealand sent thousands of diggers pouring into Otago.

beats.title: The Eureka Diamond
beats.description: Children found a sparkling pebble by a South African riverbank, the first diamond found there and a spark for later rushes.

beats.title: The Welcome Stranger Nugget
beats.description: Two Cornish miners dug up a lump of gold weighing over 70 kilograms, the largest nugget ever recorded.

beats.title: Diamonds Found at Kimberley
beats.description: A hill on a South African farm yielded so many diamonds that it became a vast hole dug mostly by hand.

beats.title: Silver Strike at Tombstone
beats.description: A prospector ignored warnings that he would find only his own grave and struck silver in the Arizona desert.

beats.title: Gold Found at Juneau
beats.description: Two prospectors guided by a Tlingit chief found gold in an Alaskan basin, starting a town and the territory's mining industry.

beats.title: Gold on the Witwatersrand
beats.description: A reef of gold-bearing conglomerate was found in the South African highveld, and Johannesburg soon sprang up around it.

beats.title: Coolgardie Gold Rush
beats.description: Nuggets picked up from the dry Western Australian scrub drew prospectors across the desert to a new boom town.

beats.title: Klondike Gold Rush
beats.description: A find on a Yukon creek set off a stampede of tens of thousands of prospectors over icy mountain passes.
beats.note: Gold found on Bonanza Creek, 16 August 1896; the stampede itself ran 1897-98. Used the discovery year.

beats.title: Gold on the Beach at Nome
beats.description: Gold found in the sands of Alaska's Bering Sea coast drew thousands of hopefuls to dig on the shoreline itself.

beats.title: The Cullinan Diamond Found
beats.description: A mine manager spotted a gleam in a pit wall and pulled out the largest gem diamond ever discovered.

beats.title: Diamonds Found in the Namib Desert
beats.description: A railway worker shovelling sand in the Namibian desert picked up a diamond, starting a rush to a barren coast.

beats.title: Platinum Found in the Merensky Reef
beats.description: A geologist traced a rich platinum layer through the South African bushveld, making the country a leading source of the metal.

beats.title: Free State Goldfield Discovered
beats.description: Deep boreholes on South African farmland struck a rich new gold reef, creating a modern mining region and new towns.
beats.note: Geduld reef strike, April 1946; earlier 1930s boreholes did not reach it.

beats.title: Diamonds Found in Siberia
beats.description: A Soviet prospecting team found the first major diamond-bearing kimberlite pipe, opening a huge mine in frozen ground.
beats.note: Mir pipe found 13 June 1955; sources agree.

beats.title: Carlin Gold Trend Discovered
beats.description: Geologists found microscopic gold invisible to the eye in Nevada rocks, unlocking one of the richest gold regions of the continent.

beats.title: Diamonds Found at Orapa
beats.description: Geologists tracing mineral grains across the Kalahari found a huge diamond pipe that would transform a poor nation.

beats.title: Jwaneng Diamond Pipe Found
beats.description: Soil sampling in the Kalahari led to the discovery of what became the world's richest diamond mine by value.

beats.title: Serra Pelada Gold Rush
beats.description: Tens of thousands of men swarmed a Brazilian hillside, hauling sacks of mud up ladders by hand in a giant open pit.

beats.title: Argyle Diamond Mine Opens
beats.description: A remote mine in the Australian outback began production and became the main source of rare pink diamonds.

beats.title: Diamonds Found in Canada's Arctic
beats.description: After years searching the tundra, a geologist found diamond-bearing rock at Lac de Gras, launching a northern mining boom.
beats.note: Fipke and Blusson's find announced 1991; the Ekati mine opened 1998.

beats.title: Bre-X Claims a Giant Gold Deposit
beats.description: A small company boasted of a colossal gold find in Indonesian jungle, a claim later exposed as one of mining's biggest frauds.
beats.note: Corrected from 1993. First 30-million-ounce claim was late 1995; the widely publicised claim was March 1996. Used 1996. The find was fraudulent.

beats.title: Lesedi La Rona Diamond Found
beats.description: A Botswana mine's scanners picked out a stone the size of a tennis ball, the largest gem-quality rough diamond in over a century.
